pressed: send script; walkTo DOWN 13 to Ask; A; ring moved to the question box with Stop showing; walkTo UP 5 to the Main tab bar; RIGHT twice to the Settings tab; walkTo DOWN 15 to 'Clear cache...' (the control whose confirm box is titled 'Clear session cache?')
seen: When the ring reached 'Clear cache...' (14:52:51), the plugin log already said 'run_game_ai_request: completed in 33.2s' at 14:52:45. The answer had finished during the walk (about 20 presses), so the clear could no longer happen while it was arriving.

verdictReason: The walk from Ask to the Settings tab's clear button takes about 20 presses, and even a strategy answer with medium thinking finished (33 s) before the ring got there.
